intro: Poker with friends, built for tournament night. Set up a table, invite your group and play Texas Hold’em with virtual chips.
subtitle: Find your next game.
noRooms: The next round starts with you.
noRoomsText: Create the first table and invite your friends.
levelHelp: One level per line: small, big, ante, minutes, break minutes.
passwordHint: Optional. The table remains visible in the lobby.
builderIntro: Start with a preset and fine-tune the rules. The preview follows every change.
descCASH: Join and leave freely. Fixed blinds and chip top-ups.
descSIT_AND_GO: One table, rising blinds and one champion.
descTOURNAMENT: Multiple tables, balanced seating and final standings.
optionalPassword: Optional · leave empty for a public room
levelHint: Set blinds, antes and breaks for each level.
afterCreate: Your room opens in waiting mode. Add bots or invite friends before starting.
previewHelp: Your seat is marked in gold. Other seats are available for friends or bots.
reviewErrors: Check field values and limits. Small blind must not exceed big blind; stack must be within the buy-in range.
changeFilters: Change your search or filters to find a game.
retentionHint: Rooms close after 30 minutes without connected people. Tournament results remain available for 1 hour.
